authority: project design only for internal contracts and persistence
Cloud evidence only when the local sources remain ambiguous

KB-001.responsibility: create, list, inspect, update and delete a knowledge space

rows.operation: create -> list -> detail -> rename -> refresh -> delete
rows.visibleResult: new card and detail use one stable ID; edits survive refresh; deleted resource disappears
rows.persistence: knowledge_spaces, default ACL, delete Job and Outbox; no duplicate audit on replay
rows.permission: creator/owner can manage; unauthorized actors receive existence-hiding errors
rows.allowedDifference: layout, component organization and localized wording may differ

rows.operation: create two sibling spaces with the same name
rows.visibleResult: both cards remain after refresh and can be operated independently
rows.persistence: two distinct Space IDs may share workspaceId, parentSpaceId and normalizedName while active
rows.allowedDifference: none; a duplicate-name conflict is a compatibility failure

rows.operation: submit empty/long names, unknown kind, invalid ACL enum, deprecated clear values and unknown fields
rows.visibleResult: invalid required inputs stay in the form with a recoverable error; UI name entry is capped at 30 characters
rows.stateTransition: no resource is created for rejected input
rows.persistence: unknown keys from the FastGPT Zod object are ignored and are not persisted; current project API caps direct names at 120 characters
rows.permission: validation runs after authentication and before persistence
rows.allowedDifference: project may report its own stable messageKey and use a different form layout

rows.operation: read, update and delete another workspace resource and omit TenantContext
rows.visibleResult: foreign data is absent and errors do not disclose the resource name or existence
rows.permission: fail closed when workspace context is missing
rows.allowedDifference: project must use its repository and ACL contracts

rows.operation: create and delete a Space and inspect ACL, Job, Outbox and audit facts
rows.visibleResult: create and delete complete atomically from the user's perspective
rows.stateTransition: active -> deleting; ACL no longer active
rows.persistence: default permission and delete Job/Outbox/audit are written once; failures leave no half-created resource or orphan
rows.allowedDifference: soft delete and Job/Outbox are project persistence mechanisms

KB-002.responsibility: folders, ordinary space type, model defaults and settings

rows.operation: create folder and child; inspect type/path; bind authorized models; refresh
rows.visibleResult: folder and child show the correct type/path; model selections persist after refresh
rows.stateTransition: create defaults then versioned model update
rows.persistence: Space parent/type/modelBindings and model binding documents persist
rows.permission: write on parent and manage on Space
rows.allowedDifference: project may organize settings in a dedicated Info panel

rows.operation: missing/cyclic/too-deep parent; unauthorized/type-incompatible model; explicit clear
rows.visibleResult: invalid targets/models are rejected with an actionable message; explicit optional-model clear persists
rows.permission: parent write and authorized model catalog required
rows.allowedDifference: control placement and message wording may differ

rows.operation: attach to another tenant parent or model and create under a parent without write permission
rows.visibleResult: foreign parent/model details are not disclosed and no child is written
rows.persistence: no cross-workspace child, grant or audit
rows.permission: tenant and ACL guards fail closed
rows.allowedDifference: project may use 403 or 404 according to existence-hiding policy

rows.operation: persist parent, type, model bindings, settings and audit
rows.visibleResult: saved summary is stable after refresh
rows.stateTransition: version and permission revision increase only where applicable
rows.persistence: Space and model binding changes commit together; failed catalog/write leaves no false authorized state
rows.allowedDifference: internal collection names follow project design

KB-003.responsibility: move, batch actions, export, references and ownership

rows.operation: single/drag/batch move, batch delete, export and ownership transfer
rows.visibleResult: successful items appear at target; failures stay at source; export starts a valid Job/ticket lifecycle; new owner is displayed
rows.stateTransition: parent/version updates; delete enters delete flow; Job queued -> succeeded
rows.persistence: path/parent/version, batch item results, ACL/owner/audit and object references are consistent
rows.permission: source write, target write, manage/owner as appropriate
rows.allowedDifference: project's export Job/ticket UI may differ from FastGPT's immediate CSV behavior

rows.operation: move to self/descendant/invalid/stale target; stale referenceRevision; ineligible owner; over-limit batch; repeated cancel
rows.visibleResult: invalid actions produce explainable errors; no valid item is rolled back because another item failed
rows.stateTransition: failed item unchanged; valid batch items remain committed
rows.persistence: no partial privileged write and no stale revision mutation
rows.permission: batch cannot smuggle an unauthorized item through a valid one
rows.allowedDifference: project may return 207 with stable per-item codes

rows.operation: move without target write permission; non-owner transfer; cross-tenant target
rows.visibleResult: forbidden actions are unavailable or rejected without leaking foreign resources
rows.persistence: no parent, owner or audit mutation
rows.allowedDifference: project may hide entries based on its permission summary

rows.operation: inspect move path/audit, batch item results, active reference, detach and ownership ACL
rows.visibleResult: new parent is visible after refresh; active references block delete; after transfer old owner is not owner
rows.persistence: owner path, ACL and audit converge in one transaction; detach requires latest referenceRevision
rows.permission: no retained ownership for old owner
rows.allowedDifference: continued read access may follow the new resource ACL but not owner-only actions
